ops:
msg: string) => exec(`git add -A && cat > /tmp/msg <<'EOF'
${msg}
EOF
GIT_EDITOR=true git -c core.editor=true rebase --continue 2>&1 | tail -3; git commit --amend -F /tmp/msg 2>&1 | tail -2; npx commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | tail -5; git log --oneline -3; git status --short | head`)
